result.reason: The clause largely tracks the preferred cap and carve-outs, but does not fully reach the playbook position. Because “Except for Excluded Claims” introduces the entire compound sentence, it may carve Excluded Claims out of both the cap and the consequential-damages exclusion, whereas the playbook specifies those claims as uncapped rather than exempt from the damages waiver. The payment clarification is also limited to Sections 3 and 4.2 rather than covering all of the Customer’s payment obligations. In addition, placing a new Section 9(c) after Section 10.7 is structurally defective. The unrelated commercial language is otherwise preserved, but the broader exception and added damages categories go beyond the minimum required.
